title: The quasi-finite locus of a separated finite-type morphism is an open subscheme of its relative normalization
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must identify the whole inverse image of an open normalization neighbourhood, not merely embed the quasi-finite locus. Elementary étale splitting isolates a finite component, normalization respects the resulting disjoint union, and descent of the local isomorphism completes the global identification.
